Sending a draft? 📝 Stamp DRAFT on every page so no one mistakes it for the final.

1. Open pdf.315tools.com and tap Watermark
2. Pick your PDF
3. Type your text and pick a color. The preview updates right away
4. Tap Add watermark and save

Free · No sign-up · Your files never leave your device 🔒
